title: Leeds beat West Ham in shoot-out to reach FA Cup semis for first time in 39 years
byline: Leeds reached the FA Cup semi-finals for the first time in 39 years as they survived a dramatic penalty shoot-out after squandering a two-goal lead in a thrilling clash with West Ham on Sunday.

title: Rice and curry, kottu, fried rice prices up
byline: Following the recent rise in domestic LP gas prices, the All Ceylon Restaurant Owners’ Association has announced that the prices of several popular food items, including rice and curry packets, fried rice and kottu, will be increased by Rs. 20.

title: Chinese national arrested over Kohuwala murder
byline: A 26-year-old Chinese national has been arrested by the Western Province South Crime Division in connection with the murder of a Chinese woman in Kohuwala on March 23, 2026.

title: 12-hour water cut imposed in Homagama and surrounding areas
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board said that water supply to Palanwaththa and the surrounding areas in Homagama will be interrupted from 8.00 p.m. today (06) until 8.00 a.m. tomorrow (07), due to prevailing dry weather conditions.

title: Rishini Weeraratne bags Platinum Excellence Award
byline: Rishini Weeraratne, Editor of ’The Sun’, was honoured with the Platinum Excellence Award for Media Influence, Storytelling, and Women’s Empowerment at the Platinum Excellence Awards 2026, held at Cinnamon Life, Colombo.

title: NDB Bank fraud shock deepens to Rs. 13.2 bn
byline: National Development Bank PLC (NDB) said an internal fraud has been quantified at about 13.2 billion Sri Lankan rupees, sharply higher than earlier estimates.

title: No Cabinet discussion on extending judges’ retirement age: Justice Minister
byline: Expressing his views on opposition politicians’ allegations that the Government is planning to extend the retirement age of Supreme Court and Court of Appeal judges, Justice Minister Harshana Nanayakkara told the Daily Mirror that the Cabinet of Ministers has not discussed anything in that regard.

title: Three villagers trampled to death in Anuradhapura
byline: Increasing the death toll in the human-elephant conflict in the Anuradhapura district, three villagers- two of them in Eppawala and the other in Priyankaragama- had been trampled to death by wild elephants last mroning. They had died at the scene.

title: Fuel stocks sufficient for festive season; No price revisions planned: CPC
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has assured the public that fuel shipments are arriving as scheduled, ensuring stable supplies through the upcoming festive season. Managing Director of the CPC Mayura Neththikumara said that there are currently no plans to revise fuel prices during this period.

title: Oil prices choppy after expletive-laden Trump threat to Iran
byline: Oil prices saw choppy trading on Monday morning in Asia after US President Donald Trump threatened to destroy critical infrastructure in Iran unless it allows ships to cross the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Police to strictly enforce traffic laws during festive season
byline: Police said that traffic laws will be strictly enforced across the country during the festive season.

title: Cardinal makes swipe at Donald Trump on Easter Sunday, questions his Christianity
byline: In an obvious swipe at US President Donland Trump over the US-Israeli war on Iran, Archbishop of Colombo Cardinal Malcolm Ranjith said all nations are suffering today because of selfishness of one man who wants to rule the world.

title: Trump issues expletive-laden threat to Iran over Hormuz Strait blockage
byline: US President Donald Trump has published an expletive-laden post on social media in which he threatened to destroy Iran’s power plants and bridges if it failed to meet his Tuesday deadline to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to all shipping.

title: The 40 minutes when the Artemis crew loses contact with the Earth
byline: No-one will have been further from home than the Artemis astronauts.

title: Vidya’s murderer attempts sexual assault again
byline: One of the seven persons who gang-raped and murdered schoolgirl Sivaloganathan Vidya in Jaffna is 2013 is alleged to have attempted to sexually abuse a lady doctor on duty at the prison in Pallekelle, Kandy where he is kept since conviction.

title: KKR under pressure ahead of Punjab test in IPL 2026
byline: The 2026 Indian Premier League has begun with a tightly packed table, as several teams sit level on points after the opening round, with net run rate already shaping the early standings.

title: Iran demands war compensation to reopen Strait of Hormuz: Official
byline: Seyyed Mehdi Tabatabaei, deputy for communications at the Iranian president’s office, has said Iran will open the Strait of Hormuz only after receiving compensation for war damages, paid via a “new legal regime” based on transit fees.

title: Trump threatens ’’crazy b***s’’ of Iran and demands reopening ’’f***g strait’’ of Hormuz before Tuesday
byline: The president of the United States, Donald Trump, launched this Sunday his toughest warning to date, loaded with insults, against the authorities of Iran after the blockade of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. He has given them until next Tuesday to reopen the passage or, otherwise, assures that he will order a massive attack against the country’s main infrastructures.

title: WHO chief raises concerns over US-Israeli attacks on nuclear sites in Iran
byline: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, director-general of the World Health Organisation, has raised the alarm over the safety of nuclear facilities in Iran following US-Israeli strikes close to the Bushehr nuclear power plant.
